items: Complete overhaul of interactive UI: replaced all shell mockups and stubs with fully working controls
Source stage: real frame picking across Gallery, Video frame, Camera, and Files with local file copying, swap, crop editor, and fit gating
Projects list: real project deletion with confirmation dialog, recursive file cleanup, and Delete all projects in Settings
Tune stage: 8 active inspection view modes (Result with press-and-hold Before, Wipe with orientation flip, Side by side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference + gain, Channels, Scopes)
Stack editor: full 17-effect library picker, drag reordering, duplicate, delete, reset to defaults, undo/redo, and typed controls (slider, switch, dropdown, color)
Fit stage: foreground service look fitting with determinate 6-step progress, cancel, metrics (mean & p95 Delta E), and before/target/recreated/heatmap viewer
Export stage: seamless export to Downloads/MOTIONSALT/CC Studio/, pack collision resolution, and success sheet with Share and Open Keyflaw actions
Data & testing: built-in demo project generator with synthetic test charts, zero-stubs CI enforcement, and zero network permissions
MOTIONSALT CC Studio: 100% offline mobile Android color grading studio and Keyflaw 1.4.9 effect builder
Multi-stage color solver: 1D Tone curves, 3x3 chromatic matrix regression, and 3D residual lattice with Laplacian smoothing
True identity Hald Level 8 (512x512) PNG generation and 33x33x33 .cube LUT export with zero distortion
Real-time preview renderer with 8 inspection view modes: Result (with hold Before), Wipe, Side-by-side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference with gain, Channels, and live Scopes
Four live scopes: RGB Parade, Vectorscope, Histogram, and Waveform
Native Keyflaw 1.4.9 .kfpack exporter: single fused shader or full suite packaging directly to Downloads/MOTIONSALT/CC Studio/

17 built-in in-scope effects: 3D LUT, Brightness/Contrast, Exposure/Gamma, Levels/Curves, White Balance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Selective Color, Channel Mixer, Sharpen, AE Unsharp Mask, Clarity, Glow, Tritone, Haze Flare, Vignette, and Film Grain
Zero telemetry, zero internet permission, fully offline standalone operation
